name: Lavua
source:
A fudashi from the Red Country. A young man the protagonist meets in the Yellow Country. He is violent, but has a big brotherly and daring personality. Raised in a slum as a child, he can be a bit of a handful when dealing with ruffians...

"It's nothing. I just wondered if there are people like you in the Yellow Country."

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
